inlines.v: HA'IRY, adjective [from hair.] Overgrown with hair; covered with hair; abounding with hair. Esau, my brother, is a hairy man. Genesis 27:11. 1. Consisting of hair; as hairy honors. 2. Resembling hair; of the nature of hair.
